confirmed_task:
Using the JPL Small-Body Database response for 99942 Apophis, report object.fullname, orbit_class name and code, orbit.epoch, the absolute-magnitude value and uncertainty, the diameter value, uncertainty and unit, and the potentially hazardous asteroid flag.

Stopping condition: Stop after all requested object, orbit, and physical-parameter fields have been recorded from the response.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied NASA/JPL SBDB response.
- Read the hazardous status from object.pha and orbit class from object.orbit_class.
- Read absolute magnitude from the phys_par record named H and diameter from the phys_par record named diameter.
- Preserve the epoch, values, uncertainties, units, boolean, and designation exactly as returned.
